title: When to Consider Rhinoplasty

html:
Rhinoplasty is an aesthetic surgery that changes the shape of the nose. The main goal of the surgery is usually to change the appearance or functionality of the nose. Since you alter bone, skin and cartilage with rhinoplasty, almost any major problem involving the nose can be fixed with the surgery. If you are having any physical or functional problems with your nose, then it may be time to see us to get a rhinoplasty consultation.

The most common reason to consider rhinoplasty is that you are extremely unhappy with the appearance of your nose. It does not matter if you have hated the appearance of your nose since birth or if you recently suffered an injury changing the appearance of your nose. Rhinoplasty will be able to alter the size, shape and proportions of your nose to achieve exactly what you are looking for. There is no reason to hate the way you look when you can easily fix the problem with a simple surgery.

Another reason to consider rhinoplasty is if you are suffering from breathing problems. Rhinoplasty can help if you have an airway obstruction in your internal nasal passage or if the external framework of your nose is causing breathing problems. Some of the most common factors causing breathing problems are nasal polyps, a nasal valve collapse or a deviated septum.

You may be suffering from nasal obstruction problems without even knowing it. The most common symptoms of airway obstructions are nasal congestion, dry mouth, mouth breathing at night and a reduced sense of smell. Sinus infections, sinus headaches and nosebleeds are also very common. If you are regularly suffering from some of these symptoms, then you should make an appointment with us immediately. We will be able to determine the cause of your breathing problems, and get them fixed before they cause any more serious issues.

In addition to being unhappy with the appearance or functionality of your nose, you must also be willing to undergo the risks of the surgery. You can reduce surgery risks by avoiding blood thinning medication several weeks before the surgery. You must also quit smoking for the same amount of time to reduce your chances of an infection.

If you have been suffering for too long, then it may be time to consider rhinoplasty. Make an appointment today with Hanemann Plastic Surgery. During the consultation, we will determine that rhinoplasty is the best procedure to benefit you. You will regret not considering the surgery earlier once you have a great looking nose that does not cause any breathing problems. Get started today.
